_comment: The build order of section 11 of the brief, as a tracker: one row per step with its state and the release that delivered it. Rendered on admin/comms.html by gen_versions.py. plannedVersion is what the brief wrote; releases bump the third digit (brief-corrections C15), so the delivered version differs.
